rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: GCC Intelligence provides regulatory intelligence for Gulf Cooperation Council markets, covering ZATCA e-invoicing requirements and Arabic natural language processing. It surfaces compliance rules, invoice validation logic, and Arabic text handling capabilities for AI agents operating in GCC jurisdictions. The server installs as an npm package with no external dependencies.
